name: Alimosho Flood 2022
cause_prelim: Two days of citywide rain on wet ground (70–98 mm in the prior 7 days): 8 Jul 07:00–19:00 (AOI 70 mm, cores to 47 mm/h over the lagoon), 9 Jul 06:00–16:00 (AOI 41 mm). Both days' cores fell within an hour of high tide (12:00, 13:00) — rain–tide compounding plausible near the lagoon; Alimosho (where the deaths were) is ~20 km inland, so local drainage/canals more likely there. Alimosho cell: 85 + 71 mm (IMERG + EOT20)
cause_plain: Two days of citywide rain (8–9 Jul) on wet ground (70–98 mm in the prior 7 days), with bursts to 47 mm/h. High tide during heavy rain was plausible near the lagoon; Alimosho, about 20 km inland, was more likely local drains.
open_questions: Exact timing of the deaths in Oke Isagun / Agbado Oke is not reported — which day's rain?
Alimosho is inland: was the killer flood a canal/stream overflow (local drainage) rather than tide-locked lagoon outflow?
No Sentinel-1 pass during the flood (none within the window)
Media evidence: 9 of 14 quotes verified; 5 behind blocked sites (see evidence meta.review)
